 Job Summary

 We are seeking a skilled Snowflake Developer - II to join our Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining data solutions on the Snowflake Cloud Data Platform. The role involves building scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, ETL/ELT processes, and ensuring efficient data integration from multiple sources.

 The candidate should have strong expertise in Snowflake, SQL, data modeling, cloud technologies, and modern data engineering practices. This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, data architects, analysts, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality, data-driven solutions.

 Snowflake Developer - Data engineering, analysis, data warehouses, data lakes. Specialist understanding and experience of methodologies like data warehousing, data visualization, and data integration.  Strong Understanding and proven experience with relational database technologies (Oracle SQL & PL/SQL or similar RDBMS), preferably Snowflake or other Cloud Data warehousing services.  Outstanding SQL skills and experience performing deep data analysis on multiple database platforms. 

 Key Responsibilities

 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable data warehouse solutions using Snowflake.

 Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines for loading and transforming large datasets.

 Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and database objects.

 Implement data integration processes from multiple on-premises and cloud sources.

 Optimize Snowflake performance through query tuning, clustering, partitioning, and warehouse management.

 Develop data transformation logic using SQL, Snowflake Stored Procedures, and Snowpark.

 Collaborate with Data Engineers, Analysts, and Business Teams to understand data requirements.

 Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data-related issues.

 Ensure data quality, governance, security, and compliance standards are maintained.

 Support production deployments and perform root cause analysis for data issues.

 Automate data workflows and orchestration processes.

 Contribute to data architecture and best practice initiatives.

 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Snowflake

 
 Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake Data Cloud.

 Expertise in Snowflake Architecture, Virtual Warehouses, Databases, Schemas, and Stages.

 Experience with Snowflake Features such as: 
 
 Snowpipe

 Streams & Tasks

 Time Travel

 Zero Copy Cloning

 Secure Data Sharing

 Materialized Views

 Snowpark

 

 
 SQL & Data Warehousing

 
 Strong proficiency in SQL and query optimization.

 Experience designing and implementing Data Warehouse solutions.

 Strong knowledge of Data Modeling concepts: 
 
 Star Schema

 Snowflake Schema

 Dimension Modeling

 Fact Tables

 

 
 ETL/ELT Development

 
 Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines.

 Hands-on experience with data ingestion and transformation frameworks.

 Experience handling structured and semi-structured data (JSON, XML, Parquet, Avro).

 
 Cloud Platforms

 
 Experience working with one or more cloud platforms: 
 
 AWS

 Azure

 Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

 

 
 Programming

 
 Experience with Python or Java for data processing and automation.

 Familiarity with Snowpark development using Python or Java.

 
 Data Integration Tools

 Experience with one or more of the following:

 
 Informatica

 Matillion

 Talend

 Azure Data Factory (ADF)

 Airflow

 dbt

 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering.

 2+ years of hands-on Snowflake development experience.

 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

 Knowledge of CI/CD practices and DevOps methodologies.

 
 Nice to Have

 
 Snowflake Certification.

 Experience with Databricks.

 Apache Spark.

 Kafka/Event Streaming.

 Data Lake Architecture.

 Terraform or Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

 Machine Learning data preparation workloads.

 
 Key Competencies

 
 Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

 Data Modeling Expertise

 Database Performance Tuning

 Stakeholder Communication

 Attention to Detail

 Collaboration and Teamwork

 Agile Mindset

 
 Experience:

 4 to 8 Years 

 Employment Type:

 Full-Time 

 Mandatory Skills:

 
 Snowflake

 SQL

 Data Warehousing

 ETL/ELT Development

 Cloud Platform (AWS/Azure/GCP)

 Data Modeling

 Performance Optimization

 
 Good to Have:

 
 Python

 Snowpark

 dbt

 Airflow

 Databricks

 CI/CD Pipeline Experience

 
 

 

 



  

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 37,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 132,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full time employees.

 This position is not available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post
